'''''Oxalis spiralis''''', the '''spiral sorrel''',<ref name=usda/> is a species of plant of the genus ''[[Oxalis]]'', a member of the wood sorrel family [[Oxalidaceae]].

==Taxonomy==
The following [[subspecies]] are accepted:<ref name=powo/>
* ''Oxalis spiralis'' subsp. ''spiralis''
* ''Oxalis spiralis'' subsp. ''membranifolia'' <small>(R.Knuth) Lourteig</small>
* ''Oxalis spiralis'' subsp. ''trichophora'' <small>Lourteig</small>
* ''Oxalis spiralis'' subsp. ''vulcanicola'' <small>(Donn.Sm.) Lourteig</small> – volcanic sorrel,<ref name=usda2/><ref name=lrn/> velvet oxalis<ref name=lrn/>

==Distribution==
''Oxalis spiralis'' is native to [[Central America]] and western [[South America]].<ref name=powo/><ref name=tropicos/>

==Cultivation==
Spiral sorrel is cultivated for its ornamental value. Several [[cultivar]]s of ''Oxalis spiralis'' subsp. ''vulcanicola'' are available, including:<ref name=lrn/>
* ''O. spiralis'' subsp. ''vulcanicola'' 'Aureus' – bright yellow-green foliage 
* ''O. spiralis'' subsp. ''vulcanicola'' 'Molten Lava' – bright yellow-green and copper-red foliage
* ''O. spiralis'' subsp. ''vulcanicola'' 'Zinfandel' – dark purple, nearly black foliage
* ''O. spiralis'' subsp. ''vulcanicola'' 'Plum Crazy' – dark purple foliage, randomly variegated
